fullTextEN: When I was 28 years old,

fullTextZH: 有一天，我收到了一封信。
fullTextEN: One day, I received a letter.
This letter was written by my 18-year-old self,
written to myself ten years later.
That is, my 28-year-old self now.
28-year-old Ahui,
Hello.

fullTextZH: 也不知道你能不能看到这封信。
fullTextEN: I don't know if you can see this letter.
Are you doing well?
Hi, 18-year-old Ahui.

fullTextZH: 你好啊，我是来自十年后的你。
fullTextEN: Hello, I am you from ten years later.
You asked a lot of questions.

fullTextZH: 我知道，对10年后的世界和自己，
fullTextEN: I know, about the world and yourself ten years later,
you have many expectations.
Have you gained or lost weight?
Long hair or short hair?
Is work going smoothly?
Do you have a boyfriend?

fullTextZH: 还喜欢那个叫张杰的歌手吗？
fullTextEN: Do you still like that singer called Zhang Jie?
Have your dreams come true?

fullTextZH: 你试过留了很长的头发，
fullTextEN: You tried having very long hair,

fullTextZH: 但是，你还是最喜欢短发。
fullTextEN: but you still prefer short hair.
You met many people.

fullTextZH: 你会有很好的朋友，陪伴你很久。
fullTextEN: You will have very good friends who accompany you for a long time.

fullTextZH: 还有人生的老师，教你怎么做一个大人。
fullTextEN: And life teachers who teach you how to be an adult.

fullTextZH: 你们一起分享快乐和悲伤，
fullTextEN: You share happiness and sadness together,
to discover a fun world.
You went to see many performances,

fullTextZH: 比如你最喜欢的歌手张杰。
fullTextEN: like your favorite singer Zhang Jie.

fullTextZH: 你后来看了很多场他的演唱会。
fullTextEN: Later, you watched many of his concerts.
You also started liking drama.

fullTextZH: 还有你一直想去的音乐节，
fullTextEN: And the music festival you always wanted to go to,
you also went many times.
And met new friends.
Once at a music festival,
you drank a lot of alcohol,
lay on the ground and cried loudly.
Although it wasn't pretty,

fullTextZH: 但你不会忘记这次美好的经历。
fullTextEN: you won't forget this wonderful experience.

fullTextZH: 你会去很多不一样的地方。
fullTextEN: You will go to many different places.

fullTextZH: 你期待的旅游，变成了一件简单的事情。
fullTextEN: The trip you were looking forward to became a simple thing.
You went to Chengdu to see the giant pandas,
Riding a bike by Erhai Lake in Dali,

fullTextZH: 在香港的山海里和朋友露营，
fullTextEN: Camping with friends in the mountains and seas of Hong Kong,

fullTextZH: 去青岛喝上了青岛博物馆的啤酒，
fullTextEN: Went to Qingdao to drink beer from the Qingdao Museum,

fullTextZH: 还在西藏穿着藏袍，认识了新朋友。
fullTextEN: Still wearing a Tibetan robe in Tibet, you met new friends.

fullTextZH: 一路上，你和很多不认识的人一起唱歌，
fullTextEN: Along the way, you sang with many strangers,
Danced together.
The world became very big, yet very small.
You will see a bigger world.

fullTextZH: 你非常勇敢地去追求梦想。
fullTextEN: You bravely pursue your dreams.
You acted in a play,
Didn't expect that, right?
You played many different
characters.
Daughter, mother,
Son, mom,
Funny girl,
Girl who broke up,
And a girl who likes girls.
You also shot a DV.

fullTextZH: 故事里的女孩坚持自己的理想，
fullTextEN: The girl in the story insists on her ideals,
In the end, she achieved her dream.

fullTextZH: 这个DV在比赛中拿了第一名。
fullTextEN: This DV won first place in the competition.

fullTextZH: 后来，你真的去电影行业工作了。
fullTextEN: Later, you really went to work in the film industry.

fullTextZH: 你问很多厉害的人问题。
fullTextEN: You ask many skilled people questions.
Every day, you see new people,
hear new stories.

fullTextZH: 你和朋友们一起创作故事，
fullTextEN: You and your friends create stories together,
very excited.
Even, you also participated,

fullTextZH: 并且主演了一个很短的电影。
fullTextEN: and starred in a very short film.
In that film,
you played a girl.

fullTextZH: 这个女孩，她在爱情里不开心。
fullTextEN: This girl, she is unhappy in love.
She argues with her boyfriend.

fullTextZH: 这个电影去了西影春光电影节。
fullTextEN: This film went to the Xi Ying Spring Light Film Festival.
Many people watched your film.
The film ended,
many people talked to you,
"I like your performance."

fullTextZH: 你在信里写的每个愿望都实现了。
fullTextEN: Every wish you wrote in the letter came true.
Mom,
I said I don't know,
I am just very foolish.

fullTextZH: 其实后来，你走了很多弯路。
fullTextEN: Actually, later, you took many detours.

fullTextZH: 路上有很多困难和新的发现。
fullTextEN: There are many difficulties and new discoveries on the road.
You changed jobs many times.

fullTextZH: 你发现，没有什么工作是完美的。
fullTextEN: You found that no job is perfect.
Stable jobs are boring,
Fun jobs don't pay well,
High-paying jobs are very tiring.
When you work in an office,
You did the same thing 100 times,
You feel it's meaningless.

fullTextZH: 你终于找到了梦想的工作，
fullTextEN: You finally found your dream job,
But you are very busy,
You can't rest.
After one year,

fullTextZH: 你银行卡里的钱比之前更少了。
fullTextEN: The money in your bank account is less than before.

fullTextZH: 于是，你又想找钱多的工作。
fullTextEN: So, you want to find a job that pays more again.

fullTextZH: 你去了一个大公司工作。
fullTextEN: You went to work at a big company.

fullTextZH: 大家都说这个公司很好，
fullTextEN: Everyone says this company is very good,

fullTextZH: 可是你每天加班到凌晨2点。
fullTextEN: but you work overtime until 2 a.m. every day.

fullTextZH: 你记得你喜欢过很多男孩。
fullTextEN: You remember you liked many boys.
That feeling was very sweet,
but love is sometimes bitter too.
You will argue.
Why argue?
It's all about some very small things,

fullTextZH: 比如今天谁做饭、谁洗碗，
fullTextEN: like who cooks today, who washes dishes,
who cleans the dirty floor at home,

fullTextZH: 你用完了东西，放回原来的地方，
fullTextEN: You put things back where they were after using them,
He didn't.

fullTextZH: 他玩很久游戏，不接你电话。
fullTextEN: He plays games for a long time and doesn't answer your calls.

fullTextZH: 他不明白你为什么生气。
fullTextEN: He doesn't understand why you're angry.
The things you want to buy,
he says they're too expensive.
You want to go to more places,
he wants to stay at home.
You might feel you're not good enough,
and also realize he only thinks of himself.
So,

fullTextZH: 如果爱情没有让你变成更好的人，
fullTextEN: if love doesn't make you a better person,
do you still want love?

fullTextZH: 你会和你爱的人互相伤害。
fullTextEN: You will hurt each other with the one you love.
You argue with your mom,
she doesn't understand your choices,
you blame her for not understanding.
She doesn't understand,

fullTextZH: 去认识新的男孩然后结婚不好吗？
fullTextEN: isn't it good to meet new boys and then marry?

fullTextZH: 为什么不要安稳的工作？
fullTextEN: Why not have a stable job?
You can eat well and have a place to live,
why are you still unhappy?

fullTextZH: 你在争吵的时候告诉他，
fullTextEN: You tell him during the argument,
you want to make your own choices,
you want to have your own life.
You said it once, twice,
many times,

fullTextZH: 直到你发现，你很难改变别人的想法。
fullTextEN: until you realize it's hard to change others' minds.
I don't know,

fullTextZH: 你是否最后成为了你想成为的那种人。
fullTextEN: Whether you finally became the person you wanted to be.

fullTextZH: 我最害怕的，就是自己不勇敢。
fullTextEN: What I fear most is not being brave.
After turning 18,
Every year on your birthday,

fullTextZH: 都是希望变成一个勇敢的人。
fullTextEN: You always wish to become a brave person.
On the last day of being 27,
I am traveling alone.
I passed by a friend's house,

fullTextZH: 晚上，他们偷偷拿出蛋糕送给我，
fullTextEN: At night, they secretly took out a cake for me,
"Happy birthday to you."
"Okay, make a wish."
That day, I realized,

fullTextZH: “变成一个勇敢的人”不再是我的愿望。
fullTextEN: "Becoming a brave person" is no longer my wish.

fullTextZH: “如果你能改变自己的一件事情，
fullTextEN: "If you could change one thing about yourself,
what would it be?"
Before this,
I might have wanted to know earlier,
what I am good at.

fullTextZH: 但现在，好像那已经不重要了。
fullTextEN: But now, it seems that it no longer matters.

fullTextZH: 就是因为前面的这些，走的每一步路，
fullTextEN: It's precisely because of these things in front, every step taken,
that has brought me to where I am now,

fullTextZH: 才让我变成现在的这个样子。
fullTextEN: that has made me who I am now.

fullTextZH: 18岁的阿慧，我最近发现世界很大，
fullTextEN: 18-year-old Ah Hui, I've recently discovered the world is vast,
with all kinds of people.
You don't have to become someone else,
you can just be yourself.

fullTextZH: 我好像没有成为他们说的“合格大人”，
fullTextEN: I seem to have not become the 'qualified adult' they mentioned,
but that's okay.
I've recently decided to give up.
I think,

fullTextZH: 我可能知道我要的人生是什么样子的了。
fullTextEN: I might know what kind of life I want.
That's it.
It might not be that exciting,
not that complicated,
but it's still good.
18-year-old Ah Hui,

fullTextZH: 其实真的还有很多故事想告诉你。
fullTextEN: actually, there are still many stories I want to tell you.
But you have plenty of time,
take your time to feel it.
I wish you to be a brave person.
By the way,

fullTextZH: 那个夏天你想去但没去成的地方，
fullTextEN: The place you wanted to go that summer but didn't make it,
I am on the way there now.
So, don't be sad.
The place you want to go,
We will all eventually get there.
